executionScopes.title: Johnny meeting bot — ongoing work, fixes, and end-to-end validation
executionScopes.description:
## Why this exists

Umbrella epic for the Johnny Google Meet AI Meeting Bot post-MVP work.

The original join-stuck bug (Johnny-ckz.1) is fixed and the bot now reliably joins meetings (commit 979447e). The remaining scope spans:
- End-to-end validation against real Google Meet (across all modes)
- Adding/refining bot behavior modes (Autonomous, free-mode speech logic)
- Provider integration polish (TTS demo playback, ElevenLabs verification, openai-realtime fix)
- UX improvements (UI-driven Google sign-in, full-meeting context vs rolling window)
- Smoke tests and provider management UI tests

All child issues here are tracked under this single epic.

## Acceptance

- All child issues closed
- Bot has been validated end-to-end across every mode against a real Google Meet
- Provider management surface is polished and tested via UI

tasks.title: Bot join hangs at 'Johnny is joining — session #N': bot never appears in Meet, Active sessions stays 0, no logs
Local Piper TTS: smoke test fails with opaque 'exit code 1' — need easy voice install + real error surfacing
Voice interrupt doesn't actually work end-to-end: bot ignores user speech mid-utterance (reopens Johnny-har / Johnny-di9)
Bot joined but voice pipeline never runs: no transcription, no decisions, no speech, no audio bridge
Add 'Autonomous' mode: bot speaks freely per profile instructions, no whitelist, no approval gate
Bot carries the whole meeting's context (not a 6-turn rolling window) when routing and answering
Active session 'Leave now' button: UI marks session ended but bot stays in the Google Meet
Active LLM provider sometimes gets unselected (TTS and STT are not affected)
Add ElevenLabs as an STT provider (missing from Add Provider dropdown when kind=stt)
Bot speaks over user mid-sentence: partial transcripts trigger responses before user finishes
Build automated two-bot test harness to reproduce voice-interrupt failure (simulated speaker vs Johnny)
Bot loses conversation context mid-session: can't recall its own prior utterances
Voice-triggered barge-in: user can interrupt the bot mid-utterance by speaking
STT transcription of participants must never pause while bot is speaking or thinking
Approving a pending suggestion doesn't make the bot actually speak it
Pending approvals don't appear in UI until page is refreshed
Persist bot utterances to meeting history (everything the bot says)
Review and standardize bot free mode speech decision logic
Verify ElevenLabs TTS provider works end-to-end with updated API key
Execute comprehensive end-to-end validation: bot joins real Google Meet and exercises every product feature across all modes
End-to-end UI test of provider management via chrome-devtools-mcp
Smoke-test populated .env: bring stack up and verify end-to-end
LLM providers: fetch model list dynamically from each provider's API instead of hardcoding
ElevenLabs e2e plan uses library voice incompatible with free tier
Run the two-bot voice-interrupt harness end-to-end against real models, fix any bugs it surfaces
Local Piper follow-up: voice catalog fetcher fails on HF 307 redirect, plus model dirs must move to host bind mounts (~/.johnny/...)
openai-realtime STT adapter targets deprecated Realtime Beta API
Johnny — Google Meet AI Meeting Bot
Add no-CLI bot sign-in: in-browser Chromium via noVNC helper container
Read Google Docs/Sheets URLs linked in calendar event description and include as pre-meeting context
Cross-session continuity: rehydrate prior session summary for recurring events
Add UI button to trigger bot Google sign-in (CLI helper stays as alternative)
TTS providers: separate Play button to hear a demo phrase, with Stop while playing
Seed providers from JSON/config file on startup
Export all provider configurations as JSON from the UI
